host.description: Host name for the application, like 'vikunja.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

user_domain.description: NS8 user domain; empty enables local accounts. Omitted preserves existing selection.

ip_allowlist.description: Allowed client IPs/CIDRs; empty allows all IPs. Omitted preserves current policy.

ldap_email_attribute.description: Directory attribute for Vikunja email; UPN supports AD users lacking mail. Omitted preserves current choice.

ldap_sync_enabled.description: Opt in to create LDAP profiles before first login and refresh every fifteen minutes. New profiles are discoverable by name.
